boosting.protocol: 5-fold stratified CV (seed 42) on the 1,500 training proteins, mean ROC AUC; settings chosen by that CV (GridSearchCV); the 500 test proteins scored once for the chosen settings

gb_curves.protocol: GradientBoostingClassifier on the 23 descriptors; mean over the same 5 CV folds of the 1,500 training proteins (seed 42); log-loss and ROC AUC on each held-out fold

family_split.grouping: gene-symbol family: the leading letters of the HGNC symbol (e.g. OR2A4 -> OR, SLC6A4 -> SLC, ZNF91 -> ZNF); proteins without a gene symbol and chromosome ORFs (C1orf50) are each their own group
family_split.protocol: 5-fold CV on the 1,500 training proteins: StratifiedKFold (seed 42) vs StratifiedGroupKFold by family (seed 42)

ladder.protocol: 1,200 fit / 300 validation / 500 test (Week 7 test split); settings chosen on validation ROC AUC; test set used once per pipeline; 95% CI: 2,000 bootstrap resamples of the test set; fine-tuning: mean of 3 seeds

logreg_esm_whole.label: Frozen ESM-2, whole sequence + logistic regression

logreg_esm_nterm.label: Frozen ESM-2, first 100 residues + logistic regression

hgb_esm_nterm.label: Frozen ESM-2, first 100 residues + gradient boosting

finetune_meta.protocol: Week 7 test split (500, seed 42, used once per pipeline); training 1,500 -> 1,200 fit / 300 validation (stratified, seed 42); every setting chosen on validation ROC AUC; fine-tuning repeated with 3 seeds
finetune_meta.hardware: Apple M1 Max laptop, CPU only, 8 threads

zero_shot.context: each position masked in turn within the full 110-residue precursor
zero_shot.score: masked marginal: log p(substitute) - log p(wild type) at the masked position; negative = the model finds the substitution less plausible than the wild type
